mapper.select:
select wf.id,wf.nick_name as nickName,wf.head_imgurl as headImgurl,wf.open_id as openId,pbi.name,wf.register_mobile as mobile, wf.remark,wf.crt_time as crtTime,wf.bind as isBind, case when wf.sex = 1 then '男' when wf.sex = 2 then '女' else '未知' end as sex, case when wf.subscribe = 1 then '是' else '否' end as subscribe from wx_fans wf LEFT JOIN wx_fans_bind wfb ON wf.open_id = wfb.open_id LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi on wfb.patient_id = pbi.id
and DATE_FORMAT(wf.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(wf.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(#{endTime},INTERVAL '1' DAY),'%Y-%m-%d')
and wf.bind = #{isBind}
AND concat(IFNULL(pbi.`name`,''), IFNULL(pbi.medical_number,''), IFNULL(pbi.pinyin_name,''), IFNULL(wf.register_mobile,''), IFNULL(wf.nick_name,'')) like concat(concat('%', rtrim(#{name})), '%')
GROUP BY wf.id order by wf.crt_time desc

select wf.id,wf.register_name as name,wf.head_imgurl as headImgurl,wf.open_id as openId,wf.register_mobile as mobile, wf.remark,wf.crt_time as crtTime,wf.bind as isBind, case when wf.sex = 1 then '男' when wf.sex = 2 then '女' else '未知' end as sex, case when wf.subscribe = 1 then '是' else '否' end as subscribe from wx_fans wf
AND concat(IFNULL(wf.register_name,'')) like concat(concat('%', rtrim(#{name})), '%')
GROUP BY wf.id order by wf.crt_time desc

SELECT pbi.id as patientId, pbi.name as patientName, wfb.dictionary_id as dictionaryId, pbi.age, pbi.mobile FROM wx_fans_bind wfb LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi on wfb.patient_id = pbi.id where wfb.open_id = #{openId}
